build_cnn_classification_model: build a multi-class CNN classification model for nucleotide sequence activity prediction
load_cnn_ensemble_models: load an ensemble of 5 trained CNN models from a local directory for nucleotide sequence classification
encode_sequences_to_integers: encode a list of amino acid sequences into integer arrays for CNN model input
predict_sequence_activity: predict nucleotide sequence activity classes using a trained CNN model or ensemble
trim_sequence_to_variable_region: trim a nucleotide sequence to its variable region by removing fixed prefix positions
